Budget tyres generally utilise less expensive materials and incorporate less advanced technology compared to premium brands. This can impact their performance in various conditions, potentially leading to reduced grip, longer braking distances, and a shorter lifespan. Investing in quality tyres can ultimately save you money on fuel, maintenance, and potentially even prevent costly accidents. They synchronise the crankshaft, which powers the pistons, with the camshaft, which controls the flow of fuel into and out of the engine cylinders. This precise timing is crucial, as even minor disruptions can lead to severe engine damage. Signs of a Failing Timing Belt: Ticking or Clicking Noises: Unusual sounds emanating from the engine could signal timing belt wear. Visible Damage: In some cases, visual inspection may reveal cracks, fraying, or missing teeth on the timing belt. Contact us for a free quote and experience the difference of our expert care.
